_notes: These are hard constraints, not scored factors. An action must pass ALL applicable checks here before it is even considered by the action scorer. Values are merchant-configurable defaults for the prototype.
_future_module_note: RBI's e-mandate pre-debit notification framework (24hr pre-notification, AFA thresholds) is intentionally NOT included here in v1 -- it applies specifically to recurring/subscription mandate debits, which are out of scope for this prototype's three leak types (failed payment / abandonment / overdue invoice). Flagged as a future policy module for subscription-recovery scope.
